title: Freezing Tokens
key_points: Tokens can be frozen by any account, not just the token owner.
Frozen tokens cannot be transferred or sold.
The freeze and unfreeze actions are recorded on the XRPL.
Frozen tokens will reappear in the account that froze them when they are unfrozen.
limitations: Does not cover all potential use cases or edge cases for freezing tokens.
asserts: Tokens can be frozen by any account, and this action is recorded on the XRPL.
scope: Describes how token freezing works in the XRPL system.
